name: issue-groom
description: A maintainer opens an issue; om-auto-manage-issues adds SDLC labels, a Definition of Ready check and implementation notes (ADR 0017). `authors` is the gate: the run holds Bash with no allowlist and the issue body is its input, so an issue from anyone else is groomed only when a maintainer adds `groom`. Issues a run holds or a human put on hold never match.

name: issue-regroom
description: A label only a collaborator can set: `groom` re-runs om-auto-manage-issues on one issue (an external report a maintainer vouches for, an edit, a reply). The repo-local override removes the label as its first mutation, so a label still present is a run nobody took.

name: issue-autofix
description: A human adds `autofix`; om-auto-fix-issue drives the issue to a reviewed PR on develop (ADR 0017). Held, blocked, do-not-merge or spec-pending issues never match.

name: issue-spec
description: A human adds `spec` to a `feature` issue; om-auto-write-spec lands .ai/specs/<date>-<slug>.md on a design-only PR (ADR 0017).

name: pr-autopilot
description: A human maintainer opens a PR; om-pr-autopilot diagnoses and runs the right chain, never merges (ADR 0017). Agent PRs (authored by design4pro-agent, the cockpit's gh identity) and dependabot are excluded by author; the pipeline labels exclude the race with om-open-pr, since the poller re-checks labels on every poll.
